utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So, Oren is bringing tools and Eli his coffee maker, right? Anyone else bringing something?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Ira's helping Eli sort through the tools for Gus's repair drive. I can start listing what we have and what we need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, so Ira's with Eli on the tools. Should we begin the list now?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, ready to get started at the repair drive? I can help with sorting tools and lend a hand with the heavy lifting.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm ready. I brought that old laptop I told you about for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, every bit helps! Let's see if we can get that laptop up and running.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm taking my toaster to the repair drive on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure it's this Saturday? I thought it was next weekend.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm sure. It's definitely this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye, are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive on Saturday? I'm bringing my blender and Vik is bringing his toaster.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'll bring snacks for everyone! I was thinking granola bars and fruit.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, snacks will be perfect! Noah's bringing an old radio and Eli's bringing his coffee maker, so we'll have a fun mix of things to fix.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've checked the inventory and we have plenty of parts, so we're all set for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, and I've got the list of what everyone's bringing—Tess with the toaster, Oren with tools, and Rey will carry supplies.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds like everything's in order. I'll make sure the setup is ready early Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive is on Saturday, isn't it? I keep forgetting the date.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, Saturday! And don't forget to bring any broken items you might have lying around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I'll start digging through my closet for things to bring.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, so the repair drive is set for Saturday. Just making sure everyone knows what they're bringing—Vik's toaster, my coffee maker, Jules's blender, and Dane's old laptop.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll be there with an extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, glad you're bringing an extension cord. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, did you hear? Sam's going to help out at the repair drive, and Dane's hauling an old laptop to donate. Oren even brought his tools!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great to hear, but let's make sure we're not overloading the space—I've already counted everything twice and we're set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I know, you're always on top of things! I just get excited seeing everyone pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, got it. Everyone's bringing something small, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll see what I can find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, just remind everyone to bring their stuff.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So, the repair drive is set for Saturday this time, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, Saturday. I'll be bringing the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks for stepping up with the supplies!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, I just heard Sam's helping sort tools for the repair drive on Saturday. Are you planning to come too?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm definitely planning to come! Rosa sent me a list of what to bring, so I'm all set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, it's good that you're prepared. I've been helping Eli sort through the tools, so we should have everything ready.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Gus, are you still planning to join us for the repair drive on Sunday? We could use your help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'll be there. I've got my wrenches and screwdrivers ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, Gus! I'll put you down for wrench duty. See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye! I'm so glad the repair drive is this Sunday. Everyone's chipping in—Sam's sorting tools, Opal's setting up, Rey's carrying supplies, and Tess even brought a toaster. We'll have a great day at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, Rosa, I think there's a mix-up—the repair drive is actually this Saturday, not Sunday. I'll be bringing snacks as planned.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye, but I double-checked the schedule—it's definitely Sunday. I wouldn't want you to show up on the wrong day!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: So Dane brings his laptop, right?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I've got that old laptop I mentioned. It's been sitting around forever.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, laptop's covered then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll make sure I have all the supplies ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right! Saturday, I've got some tools I can bring too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, so it'll be me with supplies, you with tools, and Vik with the toaster.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need a hand with that engine block, Sam? I've got some wrenches if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's kind of you, Gus. If you have any spare parts too, the drive could really use them.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I don't have spare parts, but I can lend my wrenches and screwdrivers to anyone who needs them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I've double-checked the inventory—we have everything we need for the repairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, glad it's all set. Just to confirm, we're still on for Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, Saturday works. But let's start early—we've got a lot of machines to get through.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sam's helping with the engine block. Tess brought a toaster, Dane a laptop, and Oren some tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've inventoried the parts, and we have plenty of materials. Gus's team has what they need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Let's schedule assembly time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Quinn, I heard the repair drive is this Saturday—did Rosa send you the list of what to bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Actually, I'm the one handling the list! I've got it right here—want me to send it to you?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh great, yes please send it over! I want to make sure I don't forget anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I've got the supply list ready; Rey is carrying the supplies and Oren has the tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I can help Eli organize the tools when they get here. The drive is still set for Saturday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, Saturday at the community center. Oh, and Tess is bringing a toaster too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what tools we already have for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Well, we've got a blender, toaster, old radio, and coffee maker coming in so far — not exactly tools, but plenty to tinker with!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: But those aren't tools. Do you know if anyone's bringing actual wrenches or screwdrivers?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Just a reminder, the repair drive is this Saturday, don't forget!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I remember. Oren is bringing the tools, right? And Eli, his coffee maker?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's right, Oren has the tools and Eli said he'd bring his coffee maker. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's on Saturday, but I might be mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it's Saturday. Sam's gonna help out, and Dane's hauling an old laptop to donate. Oren already brought some tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, Saturday. Glad Dane's bringing a laptop, that should come in handy.
